definitions.explanation: Describes information or news that is pleasant, useful, or beneficial to the listener. Literally suggests something that 'comes to the ear' — news that you'd want to hear.

examples.japanese: {耳寄|みみよ}りな⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have some interesting news for you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行者|りょこうしゃ}→旅行者：22927_ryokousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耳寄|みみよ}りな⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
examples.english: This is welcome news for travelers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳寄|みみよ}りな⟦キャンペーン→キャンペーン：10809_kyanpeen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: A campaign with great news for people who want to save money has started.

notes:
Literally "ear-approaching" — information that naturally draws your attention because it is beneficial or interesting. Almost always used to modify ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (story/news) or ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (information).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳寄|みみよ}りな⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: interesting/welcome news
- {耳寄|みみよ}りな⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: useful information
- {耳寄|みみよ}りな⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧: welcome news
- {耳寄|みみよ}りな⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧: a welcome announcement

USAGE:
Frequently used in advertising, news headlines, and promotional materials to attract attention. The nuance is that the information will benefit the listener — a deal, a tip, or good news.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{得|とく}→お得：07739_otoku⟧な: bargain, good deal — focuses on financial benefit
- {朗報|ろうほう}: good news — more formal, used in news reporting
- ⟦{有益|ゆうえき}→有益：13004_yuueki⟧な: beneficial, useful — more formal and objective
